---
title: "Incremental Lists"
format: revealjs
incremental: true
---

## Revealed one at a time

With `incremental: true` in the front matter, every list steps through its
items one click at a time:

- First this,
- then this,
- and finally this.

## Opting a list out

A `.nonincremental` list shows all its items at once, even under global
`incremental: true`:

::: {.nonincremental}
- All three
- appear
- together.
:::

## Opting a single list in

Without the global option you can still make one list incremental by
wrapping it in `.incremental`:

::: {.incremental}
- Step one
- Step two
:::
